profileLabel: Slight center-left economics (medium confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Quezon City 4th District representative with about 75 principal-authored bills, mostly tax and price relief: estate tax amnesty for indigent heirs, diesel excise abolition, VAT exemption on electricity, micro-enterprise income tax relief, restored senior-discount tax credit and broad individual relief. Also authored an across-the-board minimum wage increase and an emergency oil price stabilization mechanism.
caveat: Mostly consumer and household tax relief with an across-the-board wage bill; direction is only modestly left. Bill-list evidence only.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Broad individual and consumer tax relief and a senior-discount tax credit (-1); across-the-board minimum wage increase (-2); oil price stabilization mechanism (-1). Diesel excise abolition and micro-enterprise relief pull toward neutral. Three issues, bill-based.
